start.text:
Welcome to the English Coach Bot! 🎉
I'm here to help you improve your English vocabulary and have fun at the same time.

dictionary.text: Here you can add new words to your dictionary and practice them later.

messages.request-word: Please enter the word or phrase you want to add to your dictionary.
messages.request-meaning: Great 🔥 Now, please send me the meaning of the {{phrase}}
messages.request-confirm: Phrase: {{phrase}} Meaning: {{meaning}} Do you want to add this word to your dictionary?
messages.card-already-exists: The word {{phrase}} is already in your dictionary.
messages.card-added: The word {{phrase}} has been successfully added to your dictionary!
messages.card-failed: Sorry, I couldn't add the word to your dictionary. Please try again later.

practice.text: Let's practice your vocabulary! 🚀 You have {{count}} cards in your dictionary
practice.text-empty: You don't have any words in your dictionary yet. Add some words first.
